title: Base Realms
tagline: A 16-bit RPG battle game that lets players mint characters, battle for seasonal rewards, and enter crypto through familiar QR payments without needing DeFi knowledge.
taglineId: Game battle RPG 16-bit yang memungkinkan pemain mint karakter, bertarung untuk hadiah musiman, dan masuk ke dunia crypto lewat pembayaran QR yang familiar tanpa perlu paham DeFi.
seoDescription: I helped build Base Realms, a 16-bit onchain RPG that makes Web3 gaming more approachable through familiar payments and gameplay.
features: 16-bit RPG-style onchain battle game with platformer-inspired gameplay.
QRIS payment integration: scan & pay with Indonesian QRIS - making crypto accessible to everyone.
Fair randomness through commit-reveal mechanics for verifiable battle outcomes.
ERC-721 + ERC-1155 token standards: unique characters and mintable/burnable game items.
Social onboarding: share battle progress on Farcaster & Base App for community engagement.
Multi-currency support: battle with ETH, USDC, or IDRX depending on player preference.
featuresId: Game battle onchain bergaya RPG 16-bit dengan gameplay terinspirasi platformer.
Integrasi pembayaran QRIS: scan & bayar dengan QRIS Indonesia - membuat crypto mudah diakses semua orang.
Randomness yang fair melalui mekanisme commit-reveal untuk hasil pertarungan yang dapat diverifikasi.
Standar token ERC-721 + ERC-1155: karakter unik dan item game yang bisa di-mint/burn.
Onboarding sosial: bagikan progres pertarungan di Farcaster & Base App untuk engagement komunitas.
Dukungan multi-mata uang: bertarung dengan ETH, USDC, atau IDRX sesuai preferensi pemain.
impact: Top 5 Finalist in the Base Track at Coinbase Hackathon Indonesia 2025.
Bridges the gap between crypto and non-crypto users through familiar Indonesian payment methods (QRIS).
Separates minting from gambling - fees go to liquidity pools, not random payout schemes.
Demonstrates transparent onchain reward distribution - automatic, auditable, and permissionless.
impactId: Top 5 Finalist di Base Track pada Coinbase Hackathon Indonesia 2025.
Menjembatani kesenjangan antara pengguna crypto dan non-crypto melalui metode pembayaran Indonesia yang familiar (QRIS).
Memisahkan minting dari gambling - biaya masuk ke liquidity pool, bukan skema payout acak.
Menunjukkan distribusi reward onchain yang transparan - otomatis, dapat diaudit, dan permissionless.
